SELECT a.id, a.c_domaine, a.c_specialite, a.c_discipline, 
       a.c_formation, b.id AS tab_id, b.c_etablissement,
       (SELECT q.c_quota 
        FROM app_fd_quotas q 
        WHERE q.id = CONCAT(a.id, ';', b.id)) AS quota_value
FROM app_fd_formations a 
LEFT JOIN app_fd_etablissement b 
ON b.c_formation LIKE CONCAT('%', a.id, '%')
WHERE b.id = '#requestParam.etab#'
